items.title: Midcap, smallcap indices underperform benchmarks; end two-week rally
items.description: Indian equities are expected to witness a gradual uptrend next week, on the back of a strong Q1FY27 earnings season so far, which is likely to remain the key driver of sectoral and stock-specific performance, says Siddhartha Khemka - Head of Research, Wealth Management, Motilal Oswal Financial Services.
